purpose: Two equal V sources in parallel leave their branch currents undetermined; the deck is refused as a nonunique operating point.

oracle.derivation: ngspice 45 reports a singular matrix and does not simulate the operating point. The loop current of V1 and V2 appears in no equation, so any split of the 1 mA load satisfies KCL and KVL.

confirmed.result: ngspice exit 1: DC solution failed - / Warning: singular matrix:  check node v1#branch; Xyce exit 1: ***** Number of Unknowns = 3 / Netlist warning: Numerically singular matrix found by Amesos, returning zero

oracle.source: ngspice-45 manual (ngspice.sourceforge.io/docs/ngspice-45-manual.pdf) 2.1.4, Topological constraints: "The circuit cannot contain a loop of voltage sources and/or inductors and cannot contain a cut-set of current sources and/or capacitors. Each node in the circuit must have a dc path to ground. Every node must have at least two connections": V1 and V2 in parallel form a loop of voltage sources.
